changelog:
• Critical fix: Eliminated Xray DNS routing deadlock causing no internet
• Fixed Xray routing JSON format for UDP/TCP (string not array)
• Fixed IPv6 TUN prefix from /120 to /64 for Android 16 compatibility
• Server IP now routed direct (not domain) preventing TLS handshake loop
• Improved Diagnostic Logs: captures all engine, crash, and VPN logs
